entries.title: Required weather source expanded for decentralized Society locations
entries.summary: Editorial Studio now includes a dedicated Weather Locations manager for the public Civic Wire. South Pacific Gyre remains the initial location, while authorized representatives can search for and add places such as Chicago or Tokyo, enter coordinates directly, select land, marine, or combined conditions, and control ordering, presentation, and refresh frequency. Utopian Reference Time and the weather collection are protected required sources, and the database prevents removal of the final active weather location. Human location changes and archival actions are attributed to the authenticated civic identity in the Transparency Ledger; automatic condition refreshes remain quiet. All 74 release tests passed before publication.
entries.sourceLabel: The Utopian Society private Editorial Studio

changes: Added an actor-attributed Weather Locations table and editor
Added protected location search plus manual coordinate entry
Added land, marine, and combined condition modes
Added per-location rank, within-rank order, treatment, and refresh health
Seeded South Pacific Gyre as the initial managed location
Locked Utopian Reference Time and the weather collection as required sources
Prevented archival or pausing of the final active weather location
Kept scheduled weather refreshes out of the ledger while recording human configuration changes
